_comment: Template for the portal connection. Copy it to build/portal_connection.json (build/ is gitignored) and fill it in, or pass the same values as flags.
There is deliberately NO password field, and there is deliberately no committed default.

CLAUDE.md section 10 grants one narrow exception for a committed credential: a local throwaway service holding nothing but public open data and deleted with its build/ folder. opensearch takes that exception. This use case does NOT, and the reason is not caution but arithmetic: an ArcGIS Enterprise Portal is a real system with a real named account, its items outlive any build/ folder, and the same login usually reaches a federated server and a data store. Nothing here is throwaway.
The password comes from $PORTAL_PASSWORD or --password, and appears in no log line - every script substitutes the literal string <PORTAL_PASSWORD> instead.
A literal 'localhost' in portal_url is resolved by the federated server on its own machine, not on yours. Use the machine's real host name, matching the certificate.
